description:
Parses an HTML string (document or fragment) into an ordered list of IPageBlock objects: headings, paragraphs, ul/ol lists (including nested ones), blockquotes, pre/code blocks, hr dividers, images, tables and details/summary toggles. Opening and closing tags are paired by counting nesting depth, so nested
s and nested lists parse correctly. A becomes one BlockType.Table block plus child TableRow blocks with ParentBlockId set; HasHeaderRow is inferred from a first row made entirely of
. Only a whitelist of inline tags survives, and must use http, https, mailto or a relative URL, and everything else is dropped.

examples.title: A <table> imports as a parent block with child rows
Unsafe markup is stripped
